name: CineStream
description: One stop solution for Movies, Series, Anime, AsianDrama and Torrents (includes CineAnime: AniList + TMDB + AnimePahe). v528: Cloudflare bypass fixes - added 'Retry Solve' button in visible mode for manual re-attempt, checks cookies from www. subdomains and without scheme prefix, probes for clearance at 5 intervals after page load (1s, 2.5s, 5s, 8s, 12s), restored setSupportMultipleWindows and javaScriptCanOpenWindowsAutomatically for Cloudflare challenge compatibility, expanded cookie purge to www mirrors. All v527 features retained: JS document.cookie detection, raw User-Agent, truly invisible WebView toggle, cookie freshness check (~30 min) on app open, probe throttle once per minute, skip probe when cookie fresh, stream-link cache ~20 min, one canonical AnimePahe domain.
